title: Three new monoterpenes compounds isolated from Seriphidium terrae-albae exerted anti-inflammatory effects through the JAK/STAT and NF-kappaB signaling pathways.
authors: Zhu, Ziwei; Turak, Ablajan; Xu, Nannan; Jenis, Janar; Aisa, Haji Akber
one_liner_zh: 该文从植物中分离单萜化合物并研究其抗炎机制，涉及STAT3分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Three new monoterpenes compounds (5S, 8S)-5-(2E-butenyl)-8-methyl propionate-cyclopentanone (1), 1-Oxy, 10-keto-alpha-myrcene hydroxide (2), (3R,4R)-3-hydroxy-4-isobutenyl-cyclopentyl ester (3), along with eleven known small molecular compounds such as monoterpenes (1-7, 14), coumarin (10), and other small molecular compounds (8, 9, 11-13) were isolated from Seriphidium terrae-albae. The structures were elucidated by NMR, HRESIMS, ECD calculations, and X-ray crystallography. Anti-inflammatory activity test results showed that 9 compounds were detected to inhibit NO secretion by mouse macrophage Raw 264.7. Among them, the IC(50) value of compound 1 (9.56 +/- 0.66 muM) was relatively close to the positive control drug Andrographolide (AG) (2.70 +/- 0.39 muM). Molecular docking predicted that the target of compound 1 may be the STAT3 proteins. Further mechanism studies have revealed that compound 1 acted on the STAT3 target in the JAK/STAT signaling pathway, indicating the activation of M2 macrophages, exerted anti-inflammatory effects. Additionally, it could also reduce the cytoplasmic NF-kappaB content achieve the anti-inflammatory effect. Therefore, compound 1 has the potential to become an anti-inflammatory lead compound. This study provides reference value for the research and development of small-molecule natural product anti-inflammatory drugs.
abstract_zh: 从白蒿（Seriphidium terrae-albae）中分离得到3个新单萜类化合物（5S,8S）-5-（2E-丁烯基）-8-甲基丙酸酯-环戊酮（1）、1-氧基-10-酮基-α-月桂烯氢氧化物（2）、（3R,4R）-3-羟基-4-异丁烯基-环戊酯（3），以及11个已知小分子化合物，包括单萜类（1-7, 14）、香豆素类（10）及其他小分子化合物（8, 9, 11-13）。通过NMR、HRESIMS、ECD计算和X射线晶体学阐明了其结构。抗炎活性测试结果显示，检测到9个化合物可抑制小鼠巨噬细胞Raw 264.7的NO分泌。其中，化合物1的IC(50)值（9.56 ± 0.66 μM）相对接近阳性对照药物穿心莲内酯（AG）（2.70 ± 0.39 μM）。分子对接预测化合物1的靶点可能为STAT3蛋白。进一步机制研究表明，化合物1作用于JAK/STAT信号通路中的STAT3靶点，表明其激活M2巨噬细胞，发挥抗炎作用。此外，它还能降低细胞质中NF-κB含量以实现抗炎效果。因此，化合物1具有成为抗炎先导化合物的潜力。本研究为小分子天然产物抗炎药物的研发提供了参考价值。
